svg.title: Door unit firmware: class diagram (Assignment 1 MVP)

g.text: Door unit firmware: class diagram (Assignment 1 MVP)
ostium_core: core logic (plain C++, no hardware)
-handleCommand(command : ParsedCommand, nowEpochMs : int64_t, serverTimeMs : int64_t) : void
-reject(command : ParsedCommand, reasonCode : string, nowEpochMs : int64_t) : void
-report(command : ParsedCommand, result : Result, reasonCode : string, nowEpochMs : int64_t) : void
+add(commandId : string, expiresAtEpochMs : int64_t, nowEpochMs : int64_t) : bool
+runPoll(fetcher : PollFetcher, clock : Clock, scheduler : PollScheduler, processor : CommandProcessor) : bool
+readBody(source : ByteSource, clock : Clock, contentLength : int64_t, chunked : bool, limits : BodyLimits, out : string*) : BodyResult
Assignment 1 classes, by the names in SCRUM-54:
command client = BackendClient (PollFetcher), runPoll() in poll_service.h,
readBody() in body_reader.h (size cap and time limits)
command validator = parsePollResponse() in poll_parser.h, CommandProcessor
«utility» boxes are header files of free functions, not classes.
main.cpp creates one LockController, EventOutbox, CommandProcessor,
PollScheduler, and one of each board adapter, and wires them together.
